items.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of the exact borrow amount X; borrow_value remains symbolic.

Exact numeric borrow amount X and the resulting phantom surplus magnitude are not given, so the amount-level inequality proposedYield <= true surplus cannot be encoded numerically; the forbidden acceptance is represented as a grounded Boolean.
Report does not establish that a real auto-borrow occurred; the trigger is conditional (potential), so the condition is a scenario assumption rather than an observed fact.
